snippet.title: PSX Longplay [637] Tomba 2: The Evil Swine Return
snippet.description:
http://www.longplays.org

Played by: Tsunao

Platformer by Whoopee Camp.

Follow a pink-haired boy as he jumps and bites everything in his way to save his friend Tabby.

Gameplay is the same as the first one:  go through many areas to unlock a LOT of events.  Unlike Tomba 1, there are no missable events.  BUT...there is a missable item:  the Pot of Life as Kugara Ranch that can only be obtained while it is still cursed.  I get that, too.  You also get different outfits!  Oh, and this game's voiceover is top notch.

This longplay goes for all 133 (plus 4) events while trying to open up as many chests as possible.   There's lots of backtrack and pacing issues here and there.  Didn't bother to take off the Golden Powder.  =P -
Disclaimer: Most videos by World of Longplays use SaveStates!
